1.

By way of the present application, the applicant seeks grant of regular bail in Fir No.263/2020
under Sections 304B/498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Ipc) registered at Police Station
Mandawali.

2.  Senior counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant, on instructions, seeks to withdraw the present application with the liberty to file a fresh application after the examination of the material witnesses in the case.
3. The application is dismissed with the aforesaid liberty.
4. The Trial Court is requested to examine the material witnesses in the case in an expeditious manner.
This is a digitally signed order.
